art_direction: No Zoan face. Two asymmetric gold lunar-growth motifs. Three uniquely redesigned spatial spirit trees. Data-only touch UI.
limitations: Concept paintings are 2D references and cannot be exactly reconstructed as 3D from one camera angle without hand-authored production assets.
No physical Android FPS, memory, thermal or battery testing.
The inherited 146-entry database is not independently audited as a complete current canonical listing.
23 historically illustrated forms remain stylised, 123 remain sealed as unverified.
CDN preview availability is separate from GitHub file verification; do not infer it from tests.
assessment_note: Subjective visual estimate relative to supplied studio concept art; NOT studio parity or an objective measure of artistic accuracy.
actual_corrections: Built three independent active V32 volumetric tree mesh generators rather than selecting an inherited variant
Kept Zoan absolutely face-free; retained two asymmetric gold bough-rooted moon growth arcs; restored visible radial branches
Replaced high-frequency checkerboard colour assignment with smoother, direction-dependent polygon shading
Joined several broad orange fire volumes to Logia branches, enlarged storm depth and grew cyan ice masses around actual boughs
Rebuilt Paramecia into broad ivory and blush braided trunk with different depth blossoms and sparse gold spatial rings
Replaced V31 pipe-like waterfall meshes with four bending continuous-colour extruded sheets attached to upper island rim
Created a dedicated organic hanging fruit branch with individual stems and larger, easier-to-read mobile fruit labels
Zoomed family scenes back to show current fruit selection in tree context and widened the three-fruit arrangement
presentation_deficits_remaining: The reference paintings have bespoke sculpted geometry, custom lighting and detailed artistic composition not replicated by these procedural meshes
Zoan crowns still read as assembled large masses rather than fully hand-made woodland foliage
Logia fire, wind, cloud and ice are not yet seamlessly blended at studio-asset quality
Paramecia blossoms still lack the complex layered individual sakura petals from the reference
Sealed fruits are intentionally visually similar as 123 historical physical designs remain unverified
Actual Android long-term GPU performance and the third-party browser-preview host remain unverified
